बाबा महाकाल की नगरी उज्जैन में आपका स्वागत है!

ujjainhotels.in एक ऐसा समर्पित डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म है, जिसे विशेष रूप से बाबा महाकाल के दर्शन के लिए उज्जैन आने वाले श्रद्धालुओं, पर्यटकों और यात्रियों की सुविधा के लिए बनाया गया है। हमारा मुख्य उद्देश्य उज्जैन में आने वाले हर व्यक्ति को उसकी ज़रूरत, बजट और पसंद के अनुसार सबसे बेहतरीन और सुरक्षित ठहरने का विकल्प आसानी से उपलब्ध कराना है।
चाहे आप महाकाल लोक के दर्शन के लिए आ रहे हों, सिंहस्थ या किसी विशेष पर्व में शामिल होना हो, या फिर धार्मिक और ऐतिहासिक यात्रा पर हों—Ujjain Hotels आपको शहर के सभी होटल्स, रिसॉर्ट्स, बजट रूम्स, गेस्ट हाउस और धर्मशालाओं की सही और सटीक जानकारी एक ही स्थान पर देता है।

हमारा मिशन (Our Mission)

हमारा मिशन उज्जैन आने वाले हर भक्त और पर्यटक के सफर को आसान, सुगम और तनावमुक्त बनाना है। अक्सर अनजान शहर में सही और भरोसेमंद होटल ढूंढना मुश्किल होता है। हमारा प्लेटफॉर्म यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि आपको:

  • बिना किसी परेशानी के सही कीमत पर होटल मिल सके।
  • लोकेशन, सुविधाओं (जैसे पार्किंग, एसी, वाई-फाई, शुद्ध शाकाहारी भोजन) और रिव्यू की सही जानकारी मिले।
  • समय और पैसे दोनों की बचत हो सके।

हमें क्यों चुनें? (Why Choose Ujjain Hotels?)

  • • संपूर्ण जानकारी (Complete Directory): यहाँ आपको उज्जैन के लग्जरी होटलों से लेकर बजट-फ्रेंडली रूम्स और धर्मशालाओं तक—उज्जैन की लगभग सभी होटलों की सूची एक ही जगह मिलती है।
  • सटीक और पारदर्शी विवरण: हर होटल की कीमत, मंदिर (महाकाल मंदिर, क्षिप्रा घाट, काल भैरव आदि) से दूरी और सुविधाओं की स्पष्ट जानकारी।
  • समय की बचत: अलग-अलग वेबसाइट्स पर घूमने के बजाय अपनी पसंद का होटल कुछ ही सेकंड में चुनना आसान।

हमारा दृष्टिकोण (Our Vision)

हम उज्जैन आने वाले हर अतिथि को "अतिथि देव भव:" की भावना के साथ सही मार्गदर्शन देना चाहते हैं, ताकि उनकी यात्रा सिर्फ एक ट्रिप न रहे बल्कि एक दिव्य और यादगार अनुभव बने।

What ujjainhotels.in offers

An Unmatched Choice in Mahakal’s Abode

Whether you are searching for a serene ashram close to the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga, a budget-friendly dharamshala near the holy banks of the Kshipra River, or a premium hotel for a comfortable family stay—UjjainHotels.in brings together the widest range of trusted accommodations in Ujjain all in one place.

Honest Rates, No Hidden Fees

We understand that your journey to Ujjain is a spiritual pilgrimage. That is why we guarantee the most transparent and competitive prices with absolutely no hidden administrative fees or surprise charges, keeping your holy trip peaceful and pocket-friendly.

Instant confirmation, Stress-Free Travel

Forget the anxiety of finding a room during peak festival seasons or Sawant months. Every reservation on our platform is instantly confirmed. With just a few simple clicks, your room is secured and waiting for your arrival.

Complete Safety and Privacy

Your peace of mind is our highest priority. Our highly secure booking platform protects your personal details and encrypts every transaction, allowing you to complete payments safely and focus entirely on your spiritual journey.

Empowering Our Local Accommodation Partners

At UjjainHotels.in, we believe that every hotel, guest house, and traditional lodge in Ujjain deserves a chance to shine. We provide local hospitality businesses with a simple, powerful digital platform to showcase their properties to millions of devotees and travelers arriving from all over the world.

24/7 Dedicated Pilgrim Support

From navigating Bhasma Aarti registrations to finding local sightseeing spots, our customer experience team is available around the clock. We don’t just book rooms; we act as your local guide to ensure your stay in the ancient city is completely hassle-free.

Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://ujjainhotels.in.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

To maintain operational efficiency and transparency for our guests visiting the holy city of Ujjain, we follow a standardized cancellation and refund policy framework in accordance with Indian hospitality industry norms.

1. Standard Cancellation & Refund TrajectoriesFor all standard room reservations made directly through our website, refunds are calculated based on the precise window of time remaining before the scheduled check-in time (12:00 PM on the arrival date)

• Cancellation made 48 hours or more before check-in: 100% Refund of the advance booking amount will be issued (minus a nominal 5% banking/payment gateway processing fee).

• Cancellation made between 24 and 48 hours before check-in: 50% Refund of the advance booking amount will be issued. The remaining 50% will be retained as a retention charge.

• Cancellation made less than 24 hours before check-in: No Refund (0%) will be issued. The entire advance amount will be forfeited.

• No-Show Policy: If you fail to arrive at the property on your scheduled check-in date without prior written notice, it will be treated as a "No-Show." The entire booking will be canceled automatically, 100% of the payment will be forfeited, and the room will be released for other travelers.

2. Standard Amendment & Rescheduling Rule

• Any request to change or reschedule booking dates must be submitted via email or our official support channel at least 48 hours prior to the original check-in date.

• Rescheduling is strictly subject to room availability and seasonal tariff differentials (if the tariff for the new date is higher, the guest must pay the difference).

• No modifications or date changes are permitted within 24 hours of the scheduled check-in.

3. Peak Season & Religious Festival Exceptions

• As a standard practice in holy destinations across India, room reservations made for high-demand peak periods in Ujjain—including Mahashivratri, Sawan Maas (Mondays), Shahi Sawari days, Kartik Mela, and major long weekends—are strictly Non-Refundable and Non-Changeable.

• 100% retention charges apply for any cancellation requests covering these specific dates, regardless of when the request is submitted.

4. Early Check-out Framework• In accordance with standard Indian hotel rules, if a guest checks in and subsequently chooses to shorten their stay or depart before the confirmed check-out date, the hotel will charge for the complete duration of the original reservation.

• No partial refunds or pro-rated adjustments will be provided for unused nights.

5. Refund Processing Timelines and Mode

• Original Payment Source: All eligible refunds are credited directly back to the original digital payment method (UPI, Debit Card, Credit Card, or Net Banking) utilized during transaction checkout.

• No Cash Refunds: To maintain complete financial accountability, we do not issue cash refunds under any circumstances for online bookings.

• Settlement Window: Once a refund request is validated and approved by our system, the amount typically takes 5 to 7 business days to reflect in your bank account, depending entirely on standard banking clearance cycles in India.

6. Force Majeure & Management Cancellations

• In rare events where the property cannot honor your booking due to factors beyond reasonable control—such as severe natural disasters, structural emergencies, or sudden government-mandated travel restrictions—we will offer an alternative accommodation arrangement or issue a 100% full refund with zero deductions.

• The website/property’s total financial liability remains strictly capped at the exact amount paid to us by the guest.

Thank you for choosing ujjainhotels.in

These Terms and Conditions govern your use of our website and the room booking services provided herein. By making a reservation on our website, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms.

1. Mandatory Identity Proof (Government Regulations)

• In compliance with local law enforcement and Ujjain District Administration guidelines, every guest staying at the property must present a valid government-issued photo identity proof at the time of check-in.

• Accepted IDs: Aadhar Card, Voter ID, Driving License, or Passport.

• PAN Cards are NOT accepted as valid address proof.• Foreign nationals must present a valid Passport and Visa, and cooperate in completing Form C regulations as mandated by the Government of India.

• Failure to provide valid ID will result in the immediate cancellation of the booking without any refund.

2. Standard Check-in and Check-out Timings

• Standard Check-in Time: 12:00 PM (Noon)

• Standard Check-out Time: 10:00 AM

• Early Check-in & Late Check-out: Subject to room availability and will attract additional charges. Guests arriving early are advised to notify the property in advance, especially during peak Mahakal Darshan hours.

3. Occupancy and Extra Guest Policy

• The standard room tariff applies to double occupancy (2 adults per room) unless stated otherwise.

• Children below 5 years can stay complimentary without an extra bed.

• Any additional guest above 5 years will be charged extra as per the property’s current tariff framework, and an extra mattress/bed will be provided.

4. Special Guidelines for Peak Seasons & Festivals

• During major religious festivals in Ujjain (such as Mahashivratri, Sawan Maas, Kartik Mela, or Shahi Sawari days), heavy traffic restrictions and crowd management protocols are enforced by the local authorities.

• The hotel/website is not responsible if guests face delays in reaching the property due to police barricading, route diversions, or transport strikes.

• Bookings made during these festival periods are strictly Non-Refundable and Non-Changeable.

5. Rights of Admission & Guest Conduct (Local Culture)

• The management reserves the absolute Right of Admission. Rooms will not be provided to individuals or groups acting suspiciously, misbehaving, or violating local cultural decorum.

• Strict Prohibitions: Consumption of alcohol, smoking, and bringing non-vegetarian food inside the hotel premises are strictly prohibited to respect the spiritual environment of the holy city of Ujjain.

6. Payment, Tariffs, and Advance Booking

• Room tariffs displayed on the website are dynamic and subject to change based on seasonal demand without prior notice.

• To secure a guaranteed booking, guests must pay the advance amount specified during checkout.

Once paid, a digital booking voucher will be shared via Email/WhatsApp.

• All balance payments must be cleared at the time of check-in. In case of any online payment dispute or unauthorized chargeback claim, the booking voucher will stand canceled immediately.

7. Limitation of Liability & Luggage Safety

• While we strive to ensure a seamless experience, ujjainhotels.in shall not be held liable for any failure to provide services due to acts of God, sudden power failures, water shortage, or government restrictions beyond our control.

• Guests are responsible for their personal belongings and valuables. The management is not liable for any loss or damage to guest luggage.

8. Jurisdiction and Legal Disputes

• Any dispute, claim, or legal action arising out of bookings made through this website shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the local courts located in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, India.
